title: "until end of turn" encoded as UntilEndOfCombat (15 cards)
body:
These cards say "until end of turn" but encode `UntilEndOfCombat`, so the effect ends too early:

Accelerated Evolution, Aquitect's Defenses, Aspect of Manticore, Captain's Tutelage, Cradle of Safety, Drench the Soil in Their Blood, Fae Flight, Fire-Rim Form, Gilt-Leaf's Embrace, Goblin Skycutter, Mantle of Leadership, Military Discipline, Sentinel's Mark, Starlit Mantle, Super Speed
